verdict.rationale: Drata documents continuous monitoring of controls through monitoring tests and a monitoring training video, plus workflow automation with "custom triggers and actions" that monitor controls, evidence, and personnel. An API exposes monitoring test results and exclusions for building custom alerting. However, nothing in the pack shows failures being delivered to Slack, email, or ticketing tools, or what remediation context an alert would carry. Missing for 10: documented Slack/email/ticketing notification channels for control failures and drift, evidence of remediation context in alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
